name: BSP_Entity_IsAboveDepthChargeDepth
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_unit_gunnery_pass, read-only analysis. __thiscall(entity)(), RET 0, body 00852820-0085285A. Refreshes the pose and returns true when the world Y at entity+100h is above ([entity+1204h] + [entity+1200h]) / [00D7A2B0]. 00862820 requires it before letting the depth-charge categories 8 and 9 take a target answering IsKindOf(8). docs/UNIT_GUNNERY_PASS.md | Body 00852820-0085285A read whole: returns [sub+100h] > ([sub+1204h] + [sub+1200h]) / 3.0, with 3.0 the double at 00D7A2B0 and an 00414DB0 pose refresh when [sub+0C8h] is clear. The existing name's DIRECTION is now corroborated without relying on the name, from the two siblings that share the coordinate: 008527A0 tests [sub+100h] > [sub+1200h] - 3.0 and gates a submarine's OWN categories 1, 2, 5 and 6 through 008627A0 (deck guns need the boat near the surface), and 008527E0 tests [sub+100h] > [sub+1204h] - 3.0 and gates its category 7 (torpedoes reach deeper). 00853630's copy loop at 00853A87 fills entity+1200h..120Ch from class+80Ch..818h, and 00854230 writes class+810h from PeriscopeDepth (falling back to SwimDepth1) and class+814h from SwimDepth2, so +1200h is the surfaced reference and +1204h the periscope one. Sole consumer 00862820 at 008628A7 and 008628BE: categories 8 and 9 refuse a submarine this reports TRUE, every other category except 7 refuses one it reports FALSE, and category 7 is exempt from both - so a depth charge and any gun are mutually exclusive on the same submarine at the same instant. NOT established: the absolute sign of +100h/+1200h/+1204h; 00853630's loop writes indices 1-3 as XMM1 - classValue when the class value is non-negative and XMM1's producer was not read. docs/DEPTHCHARGE_FLAK_ADMISSION.md | EXPLICIT REFUTATION of this record's own earlier clause '00862820 requires it before letting the depth-charge categories 8 and 9 take a target'. It is inverted. The branch at 00862820 is: 0086289B CMP EDI,8 / JZ 008628A5 ; 008628A0 CMP EDI,9 / JNZ 008628B7 ; 008628A7 CALL 00852820 ; 008628AC TEST AL,AL ; 008628AE JZ 008628C7 (the MOV AL,1 return) - so a NON-ZERO answer falls through to 008628B0 XOR AL,AL / RET 8, the refusal. Categories 8 and 9 require 00852820 to be FALSE: a depth charge engages a submarine only when it is NOT above depth-charge depth. The opposite arm at 008628B7 exempts category 7 (JZ 008628C7) and, for every other category, refuses on 008628C5 JZ when the answer is zero - so guns require it TRUE. The two arms are complementary, which is the point of the routine. docs/DEPTHCHARGE_FLAK_ADMISSION.md section 3

Gram-Schmidt over the three basis rows of a row-major 4x4: 0085DC85 MOV ESI,ECX / 0085DC87 LEA EBX,[ESI+20h] makes row 2 the reference and 0085DCB9 LEA EDI,[ESI+10h] row 1. 0085DC8D CALL 00419440 takes |row 2|; 0085DC96 FLDZ / FCOMI / 0085DCA0 JBE 0085DCAC sets the reciprocal to 0.0 rather than dividing, so a ZERO ROW SURVIVES AS A ZERO ROW and then propagates into a zero row 0 through the cross product - and because the FCOMI is unordered for NaN, a NaN length takes the same branch and collapses the basis silently. |row1 . row2| is compared against the double 0.9990000128746033 at 00D0D0A0 (a 2.5625 degree cone): below it (0085DDFB) row 1 is orthogonalised against row 2, normalised, and row 0 = normalize(cross(row1,row2)); above it (0085DD26) row 0 takes that role and the cross is negated through the float -0.0 at 00D7A208, which is what proves both arms agree on handedness. Row 3 and the fourth column are never addressed. Row 2 is the only row not rebuilt, and row0 = row1 x row2 is the left-handed right = up x forward, which agrees with the project's pose convention; the independent caller 0074260E (reconstructed at src/land_and_structures.cpp:248) writes a path tangent into row 2 and world up into row 1 before calling, confirming it.
